# Town of North Hero municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 16; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Town of North Hero (official website), Selectboard page: lists the selectboard as Karl Raacke (Chair), Joe Latimer (Vice Chair), Harry Parker, Clair LaVoie, and Frank Codey; the page's 'Clair LaVoie' is a typo against the town's term table and the Secretary of State's directory, which both give Claire (the table prints the surname LaVoie)

Town of North Hero (official website), 'North Hero Elected Officials Term Lengths' table (linked from the Elections page): prints selectboard terms: Harry C. Parker to 2027, Karl Raacke to 2027, Roland (Joe) Latimer II to 2028, Claire LaVoie to 2028, and Frank Codey to 2029

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): lists North Hero's selectboard as Frank Codey, Joe Latimer (Vice Chair), Claire Lavoie, Harry Parker, and Karl Raacke (Chair)
Town of North Hero (official website), Town Office page: names Corinn Julow as Town Clerk
Town of North Hero (official website), 'North Hero Elected Officials Term Lengths' table (linked from the Elections page): prints Town Clerk Corinn Julow, three-year term to 2027
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): names Corinn Julow as North Hero's town clerk
Town of North Hero (official website), Town Office page: names Lisa Keyworth as Treasurer
Town of North Hero (official website), 'North Hero Elected Officials Term Lengths' table (linked from the Elections page): prints Town Treasurer Lisa Keyworth, three-year term to 2027
Town of North Hero (official website), 'North Hero Elected Officials Term Lengths' table (linked from the Elections page): prints Town Moderator Andy Julow, one-year term to 2027

Town of North Hero (official website), 'North Hero Elected Officials Term Lengths' table (linked from the Elections page): prints Listers Jim Kilbride (to 2027), Lisa Keyworth (to 2028, two years remaining in a three-year term), and Kathy Finck (to 2029)

Town of North Hero (official website), Listers page: names Listers Kathy Finck and Jim Kilbride and 'Lisa Keyworth (Assessor)'; the elected-officials term table lists Keyworth as an elected lister holding a term and governs

Town of North Hero (official website), 'North Hero Elected Officials Term Lengths' table (linked from the Elections page): prints five Cemetery Commissioners on five-year terms: Michael Tranby (to 2027), Tracy Giroux (to 2028), Jim Tudhope (to 2029), Majken Tranby (to 2030), and Frank Dattilio (to 2031)

Town of North Hero (official website), 'North Hero Elected Officials Term Lengths' table (linked from the Elections page): prints seven elected Library Trustees: Elizabeth (Betsy) Jaffe (to 2027), Roberta Gilmour (to 2027), Linda Darrow (to 2028), Angie Marano (to 2028), Diane Bahrenburg (to 2029), Helen McCarthy (to 2029), and Melissa Cronin (to 2030). The table fixes both the board's size and its elected status
Town of North Hero (official website), 'North Hero Elected Officials Term Lengths' table (linked from the Elections page): prints First Constable Jim Benson, one-year term to 2027
Town of North Hero (official website), Constable / Delinquent Tax Collector page: names Jim Benson as Constable
